title: Station Thread
description: A station's thread in one activation (MET-A-029). It belongs to the station, not to a person, and lives until the activation is stood down. No other fields are allowed.

station.description: The same value as station in a position report.

state.description: UNANSWERED: the message the server received last is from the station. ANSWERED: it is from the control room, or the thread has no messages. The state follows the order the server received the messages, never writtenAt. Reading a thread does not change it.

unansweredSince.description: While UNANSWERED: receivedAt of the first station message after the latest control room message. The operator's list is ordered by it, oldest first. Null while ANSWERED.

lastMessageAt.description: receivedAt of the message the server received last. Null when the thread has no messages.

messages.description: The thread's messages in the order the server received them (by id). Always present when one thread is read, left out in the list of threads and in socket events.
